value.rationale: The 2024 four-stage IPFE correction was designed for deterministic stiff stability and second order yet amplifies independent stochastic stage noise quadratically in inner-step ratio. Necessary/sufficient correlation scaling and uncoupled sampling cost are structural solver design boundaries; a different deterministic-stable two-stage PFE has bounded noise floor. A motivated loss-of-robustness example with exact limits, not a routine recomputation of the source deterministic table.
